_what: QC for curation/dahlmanje_30394729 -- Sago, Lokugamage, Islam, Krupczak, Sato, Dahlman, J Am Chem Soc 140(49), 2018, PMID 30394729, 'Nanoparticles That Deliver RNA to Bone Marrow Identified by in Vivo Directed Evolution.' Assembled by 10_qc.py from the stage outputs; numbers are composed, not retyped.

THE_GOVERNING_NUMBER.which: 7C1 only, in every formulation of both libraries and in every individually tested LNP.
THE_GOVERNING_NUMBER.note: A corpus keyed on ionizable-lipid structure gains ONE lipid from 160 formulations -- and gains zero, because that one lipid has no single SMILES.

N1_normalisation_reconstructed_from_the_.formula: nd_i = [ (c_i / sum_k c_k) / (in_i / sum_k in_k) ] / sum_j[ same ] x 100%

stage_3_normalised_delivery.verdict: 9/9 EXACT, residual 0.0. The normalisation is count-share divided by input-share, renormalised to 100% across the pool -- so the readout is COMPOSITIONAL.

stage_2_printed_intermediates.verdict: 10/12. Two printed cells in the Mouse 2 column are wrong: 34 where 80/230 = 34.78 rounds to 35, and 3 where 45/230 = 19.57 rounds to 20. Stage 3 is computed from the RAW counts and is still exact, which is what shows these are typos in the intermediate table rather than a different formula. Confirmed visually on the page render, not only from the text layer.

the_drawn_but_never_computed_total.verdict: 'Total (%) = 100' is DRAWN under all three tables and computed under none: the stage-2 columns sum to 100 / 83 / 101 / 99 and every stage-3 column sums to 101.

F1_factorial_proved.verdict: 5 x 24 = 120 and 2 x 20 = 40, with every PEG variant carrying the IDENTICAL ratio set exactly once and zero duplicates. The claimed factorials are proved, not taken on trust.

M1_molpct_sums.verdict: 158 of 160 formulations sum to exactly 100 mol%. The two that do not are library 2 LNP 36 and LNP 40, both 60/45/5/0 = 110, at a stride of 4 across the two PEG blocks -- one error in a block that was pasted twice. NOT a tautology of our own derivation: the four columns are transcribed independently from native PDF text cells and nothing here computes one from the others.

Fig_4A.verdict: 5/5 slices exact, including 20.83 -> 21 and 16.67 -> 17, which also PINS the band convention as [lo,hi) with '>20' meaning >=20. One wrong PEG value anywhere in the 120-row table would break a slice, so this validates the whole transcription.

Fig_5H.verdict: DOES NOT RECONCILE under either convention: printed 40/40/20 against 45/20/35 (the convention Fig 4A pins) or 45/40/15 (inclusive). Only the middle slice ever matches. Reconciliation would need exactly 2 of the 40 LNPs to move from the low band to >20, and exactly 2 LNPs (36 and 40) independently fail the mol% sum -- a convergence recorded as a hypothesis in 08_contradictions.csv, NOT as a conclusion, because the 33-35 series pattern implies the opposite repair.

E1_formulated_pies_vs_the_composition_ta.the_other_four: Fig 4B 20/20/20/20/20, Fig 5I 50/50, Fig 5J 20/40/20/20, Fig 5K 60/40 -- all exact against the tables, no rounding needed.

T1_total_formulated.note: Fig 1D draws '2x; 160 LNPs tested in vivo' and never computes it; 120 + 40 reproduces it exactly.

W1_the_five_individually_tested_formulat.verdict: All five compositions printed in Fig S3A / Fig 6A are found where they should be: BM1 = library 2 LNP 18, LNP1 = library 2 LNP 6, LNP3 = library 2 LNP 19, the screen-1 winner = library 1 LNP 25. The screen-1 winner's ratio ALSO appears as library 2 LNP 34, which is not an error -- library 2 was evolved from library 1 and deliberately re-tested that ratio with both PEGs. The 'original' 80:20 7C1 is in neither table, as expected: it is the comparator, not a library member.

P1_a_round_number_implied_but_never_prin.verdict: 45 x 44.05 = 1982.4 Da, 0.9% from the printed 2000 -- the drawn repeat count is consistent with the label and was never multiplied out in the paper.

token_pattern_test.verdict: A substring join on the bare token '7C1' captures 36 corpus rows spanning 35 distinct structures across 4 experiments, and NOT ONE of them is Dahlman's 7C1 lipomer: they are combinatorial labels in which the characters happen to co-occur (KL_2010 '117C14' = head 117 + C14; LL_2012 'A7C10'; LM_2019 'A1Iso7C11'; ZH_2023 'A4I18R7C18-2'). The paper's own '7C1' is a compound index from Dahlman 2014, not a composition: the '7' is the amine and the 'C1' is the epoxide index, while the drawn tail is C13 and the epoxide is C15. Three different numbers, none of them a chain length.

substructure_sweep_SUPERSET.verdict: The loose amino-alcohol pattern matches 1,247 of 18,720 vitro and 276 of 1,506 vivo structures -- a CHEMOTYPE, reported as a superset. The strict pattern (the full drawn C13 arm) matches 0 and 0.

in_vivo_shared_chemistry.why: This paper's only ionizable lipid is 7C1, which has no SMILES and is absent from the corpus under any name. It adds no shared in-vivo chemistry. It also uses no benchmark ionizable lipid at all -- no MC3, no SM-102, no ALC-0315 anywhere in the paper; its only comparator is its own 80:20 7C1 formulation.

C1_corpus_overlap.benchmarks: NONE. The paper uses no MC3, no SM-102, no ALC-0315 and no other field benchmark anywhere; its only comparator is its own 80:20 7C1 formulation. So the 'do benchmarks top the screen' question does not arise here, and the paper's own lead BM1 does top its own screen 2 by construction -- it was SELECTED as the top performer, which is not an independent finding.

7C1.why_empty: the paper draws no complete structure

discarded_cholesterol_stereo_attempt.verdict: DISCARDED, not tuned. Recorded so the hazard is visible.

A1_anchors.verdict: DSPC was assembled from sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine and two stearoyl fragments and agrees with the registry by FULL InChIKey. The 7C1 representative arm was assembled with the regiochemistry pinned by atom map; its Markovnikov isomer has the identical formula AND the identical exact mass to six decimals (0.0 Da difference) and a different InChIKey, which is how the gate is shown to test connectivity. Cholesterol is emitted at CONNECTIVITY ONLY after the hand-written stereo attempt produced a diastereomer; it was discarded rather than tuned against the registry.

S1_seeded_mutation_gate.a_seed_that_was_NOT_credited: The first E1 seed moved one library-1 PEG value from 20 to 22.5 and was a NO-OP, because the half-open convention already puts 20 in the '>20' band. It exited non-zero -- on the factorial, not on E1 -- while E1's metric never moved, so it was refused. That is why 'credited' requires the metric to MOVE and not merely a non-zero exit.

caveat_without_a_note_raises.message_head: emit_rows('seed-no-note') item 'original_7C1': this row carries a caveat (confidence='low', positional_ambiguity='', structure_assumed='1', value_is_bound='') and its curation_note is empty.

example.curation_note: 7C1 is a polydisperse branched-PEI(Mn~600)/C15-epoxide polymer; the paper draws only one representative arm, so no single SMILES is correct. Formulation 80.0/0.0/20.0 mol% with C14PEG2000; value from Fig S3B bar 1 (=1.0 by definition: the normaliser).
